explanation: Metaphor appears in the line `melodious birds sing madrigals`(note also the alliteration), in that it is an indirect comparison of bird song with elaborate Italianate music. Much of the poem involves hyperbole, or exaggeration, e.g. àll the pleasures, thousand fragrant, etc.
